claim: The court held that prolonged restraint of a pretrial detainee in stress positions without medical evaluation constitutes cruel and unusual punishment under the Eighth Amendment. Officers who knowingly authorize or fail to intervene in such treatment may be held individually liable under 42 U.S.C. § 1983.
citation: Uxbridge v. Meridian Falls Police Department, 673 F.2d 441 (5th Cir. 1989)
initial_reasoning: The case Uxbridge v. Meridian Falls Police Department (5th Cir. 1989) addresses police misconduct and civil liability but does not discuss prolonged restraint in stress positions, cruel and unusual punishment, or 42 U.S.C. § 1983 liability for such conduct. Therefore the citation does not support the claim.
